"Come on Chas, get a move on"! Unfortunately, Belgrave were unable to muster either an M40 or M50 team so in the end it was decided to combine the eight runners we did have available to compete in the M40 event.

Handicapper Arthur Bruce recalled the day 45 years earlier when he and Chas first met. They battled their way up the "kiss of death" together with the latter chattering incessantly as the ascent was made.
Below: All smiles on the podium. Gold medallist Chas. is flanked by Van Noten (Belgium) who ran 16:16.43 and Kotnik (Slovenia) 16:18.06.
